product.name: Monoprice Cat6A CMR Bulk Ethernet Cable - UL TAA Shielded (F/UTP) Solid 23AWG 550MHz 10G Pure Bare Copper Spool in Box 1000ft White
product.description: Monoprice™ 23AWG Cat6A 550MHz F/UTP Solid, Riser‑Rated (CMR) Bulk Pure Bare Copper Ethernet Cable is premium, high‑speed cabling designed for use in 10GBase‑T (10Gbps) network environments. Constructed using 23AWG solid, pure bare copper conductors with a CMR‑rated PVC jacket, it exceeds TIA/EIA 568‑C.2 standards and is safe for use in the Riser spaces of commercial class buildings. F/UTP cables are a hybrid between shielded (STP) and unshielded (UTP) type cables, incorporating an overall foil shield, while leaving the twisted pairs unshielded.
